sourceTitle: 5G outdoor geographic coverage, UK local areas, January 2026
sourceAttribution: Office for National Statistics, 5G coverage, January 2026; underlying data: Ofcom, published 13 May 2026

workbookReadOnlyCheck.notesB4: Percentage of geographic areas with 5G signal outdoors from at least one operator, threshold -110 dBm, as of January 2026

draftQuestions.status: replacement draft for the earlier Highland-Scotland percentage-point question; not independent Gold
draftQuestions.question: ONS《5G coverage》2026 年 1 月工作簿中，Highland 的 35.20% 表示什么覆盖指标？这份工作簿能否给出 Highland 的住户室内 5G 覆盖率？请引用指标定义与原始单元格。
draftQuestions.draftAnswer: 35.20% 是 Highland 地理面积中，室外达到至少一家运营商 5G 信号、阈值为 −110 dBm 的比例，时间为 2026 年 1 月。工作簿未提供住户室内覆盖率，不能由 35.20% 推得该比例。

developmentPatternDecision: The earlier two-area percentage-point difference draft is superseded as a candidate, not deleted from history. This replacement tests the source-defined outdoor geographic-area denominator and a requested household-indoor value absent from this workbook; it does not ask for a two-area subtraction. It shares the Highland value and denominator topic with the earlier draft, so the two cannot count as independent questions.

oldQuestionScreen.screenBindingScope: Source SHA, draft ID, question and draft answer are unchanged; this receipt subsequently appended the screen and clarified the status and cross-draft decision.
oldQuestionScreen.manualTopTen: The first five nearest questions ask whether a 2.5G Ethernet port means 5G cellular. The rest concern PoE support, device deployment scenes and opening revised device material. None asks the Highland outdoor-geographic-area denominator or a missing household-indoor value.

limits: Workbook-wide term absence is a bounded check, not proof that no conceivable proxy for household indoor coverage exists. BGE neighbors and manual review do not establish full development-exposure or source-family independence; set-level audit and user-visible answer quality remain pending.
